title: Merchant Acquisition Strategy Sr. Manager
description:
Role Summary

As the Merchant Acquisition Strategy Manager, you will shape how Keeta grows its merchant supply in Brazil. This is a strategy and analytics role, not a customer-facing account management position. You'll work at the intersection of data, market knowledge, and commercial judgment: building a clear view of the merchant landscape, and designing the playbooks that give our business development teams a real edge.

Key Responsibilities

1. Merchant Targeting & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain a structured view of the merchant landscape, segmented by category, price tier, and geography, to define acquisition priorities.
  • Identify high-quality merchant targets by combining platform data with on-the-ground market knowledge — knowing not just who to sign, but why and when.
  • Continuously refine the target pipeline based on evolving business needs and market dynamics.

2. Acquisition Strategy & Proposition Design

  • Develop differentiated acquisition strategies for different merchant segments, including value propositions, timing, and resource allocation logic.
  • Assess brand and merchant value to determine appropriate partnership terms and investment levels.
  • Translate platform capabilities — traffic placements, promotional support, operational resources — into compelling, merchant-specific propositions.

3. Market Intelligence

  • Develop a deep, current understanding of Brazil's F&B and restaurant ecosystem: which categories are growing, which brands are underserved, and what drives merchant decision-making on platform choice.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and surface actionable insights to inform strategy and prioritization.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with business development teams to ensure strategies translate into executable, on-the-ground playbooks.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, and Marketing to align platform capabilities with merchant acquisition needs.
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations on data infrastructure and reporting;
    your focus is the strategy layer, not pipeline administration.

Basic Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in strategy, merchant/supply operations, or business development at a platform or marketplace company.
  • Strong analytical skills — able to work with large datasets, use SQL or BI tools, and turn analysis into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Deep knowledge of the food delivery or local services industry, including how merchants evaluate and engage with platforms.
  • Fluent English;
    Portuguese fluency strongly preferred for local market effectiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a leading food delivery or on-demand platform — you understand the competitive dynamics from the inside.
  • Background in supply strategy, merchant growth, or commercial strategy with a demonstrated track record of building and executing acquisition playbooks.
  • Ability to assess merchant and brand value — focused on sign quality, not just sign volume.
  • Consulting or structured problem-solving background is a plus.
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything has a playbook yet.

Why Join Keeta?

  • Own the strategy, not just execute it. You'll define who we go after and how — with real influence over outcomes.
  • Brazil's F&B market is genuinely complex. The problems here require real analytical depth and local market intuition — it's not a market where generic playbooks work.
  • High-impact, high-visibility work. Merchant supply quality is one of the core levers of platform growth, and this role sits at the center of it.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:

  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);

  • Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
  • Gestão/mediaçãode negociações e conflitos;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;

  • Gestão de escopo, identificando potenciais desvios (técnicos ou contratuais), monitorando prazos, obrigações e responsabilidades das partes do contrato.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: gestão de disputas, arbitragens e/ou de projetos, formação de preço/orçamento, planejamento, gestão de custos;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, RMP, IPMA, CCM, etc.);

  • Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.

Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

SOBRE A CENTAURO:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado, afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Field Cto
description:
WSO2 is looking for a visionary Field CTO to join our Latin American Sales Engineering team. As a company at the forefront of API Management, Integration, and Identity & Access Management (IAM), WSO2 provides the foundational "digital freedom" for enterprises to innovate without vendor lock-in.

The Field CTO is a high-impact, senior-level technology sales professional who acts as the "voice of the technology" in the field. You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives at our most strategic accounts, providing thought leadership and architectural guidance that aligns WSO2's open-source and SaaS solutions with our customers' long-term business goals. This is a hybrid role that demands the technical depth of an architect and the influential communication of a senior sales executive.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Represent WSO2 at major industry conferences, executive roundtables, and in the media. Author white papers, blogs, and reference architectures that define the future of digital transformation and decentralized integration.
  • Strategic Sales Support: Partner with the Latin American sales team to lead "top-down" technical engagements. You will own the technical relationship with CXOs, helping them understand how WSO2 fits into their broader enterprise ecosystem.
  • Architectural Advisory: Provide high-level architectural oversight for strategic pre-sales opportunities and critical post-sales implementations. Ensure that customer deployments are scalable, secure, and follow industry best practices.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback Loop: Act as a bridge between the Latam market and WSO2 Product Management. Translate customer challenges and market trends into actionable product requirements to influence the roadmap of our internal developer platforms and SaaS offerings.
  • Post-Sales Strategic Alignment: For key accounts, continue to provide periodic executive-level reviews to ensure the realized value of the WSO2 platform and identify expansion opportunities based on the customer's evolving digital roadmap.
  • Mentorship: Act as a mentor to the broader Sales Engineering team, elevating their ability to communicate business value alongside technical features.

Qualifications, Skills, and Relevant Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in technical sales, enterprise architecture, or professional services, with at least 3 years in a leadership or "Field CTO" equivalent role.
  • Proven track record of selling to and advising Fortune 500 companies within the Latin American or North American market.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical knowledge in at least two of the following technical domains: API Management, Enterprise Integration, Microservices, Identity & Access Management (CIAM/IAM), Internal Developer Platforms, and AI
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent business experience is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts into business outcomes for CEOs, CTOs, and CISOs.
  • Strong understanding of the open-source ecosystem, cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, Docker), and SaaS delivery models.
  • Ability to pivot between a deep-dive technical discussion with architects and a value-based business discussion with a CIO or CFO.
  • Ability to see beyond a single transaction to build a multi-year partnership with a customer.
  • Exceptional public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel across Latin America (approximately 30-40%) to engage with customers and attend industry events.
  • Fluent English & Spanish

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility
  • Ongoing training, coaching, and mentoring
  • Education reimbursement for professional qualifications and courses
  • A generous vacation/leave plan that fits your needs
  • Health insurance for you and your family

Diversity Drives Innovation

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation;
it also ensures that wecan create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. title: Gerente Funcional De Turno - Fábrica
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Coordenar as demandas da fábrica alinhadas às estratégias de atingimento de resultados e munido de informações para as melhores tomadas de decisões referente ao balanço da fábrica, durante os turnos de trabalho e através do monitoramento dos indicadores de produção, em tempo real, avaliando e intervindo nos processos, aspectos e parâmetros, baseado nos procedimentos de tomada de decisão, visando a qualidade, a produtividade e a otimização dos custos de produção, garantindo a segurança dos colaboradores.

Principais Atividades:

  • Garantir a capacitação, treinamento técnico e legal (NRs) da equipe operacional, especialmente durante o startup e operação da planta.
  • Desdobrar e comunicar o plano estratégico corporativo à equipe de turno, assegurando o cumprimento das metas da fábrica.
  • Gerenciar a operação integrada do processo produtivo, da entrada da madeira à expedição da celulose, garantindo segurança, qualidade, produtividade e custos.
  • Coordenar e liderar equipes de operação e manutenção durante o turno, assegurando adequada alocação de recursos, gestão de conflitos e engajamento do time.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos e operacionais, atuando em ajustes de processo, manutenções e paradas emergenciais.
  • Participar do planejamento estratégico da produção e da Parada Geral, identificando gargalos, riscos e oportunidades de otimização operacional e de custos.
  • Monitorar e gerir os indicadores de desempenho (SSMA, Qualidade, Produção e Custos), promovendo ações corretivas para o atingimento das metas e do EBITDA do negócio.
  • Elaborar e reportar informações de desempenho do turno, assegurando a continuidade operacional e a efetiva comunicação entre turnos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua, inovação e modernização de processos, equipamentos e ferramentas de gestão.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.

Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability

O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição

  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.

Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Backfill Support Engineer
description:
Title: IT Support (Backfill)

Contract: Long Term

Location: Ibirubá, Brazil United States

Scope of Work

This is a Backfill IT Support (Deskside Support) position for one of our clients in Jundiai, Brazil

The selected candidate will provide on-site technical support covering IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, and hardware troubleshooting. You will work closely with internal teams, customer teams, and remote technical specialists to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Responsibilities include monitoring system health, supporting network devices, troubleshooting VOIP phones, managing basic server tasks, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations following SLA guidelines.

Who We Are – Teceze

Teceze is a global IT solutions and managed services provider, delivering end-to-end support across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. We specialize in providing reliable, secure, and scalable IT services that empower organizations to operate seamlessly. By joining Teceze, you become part of a highly collaborative and technically strong team focused on excellence, innovation, and customer success.

This role is being offered as a backfill position for one of our key clients, ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining service quality on-site.

Job Description:

Basic Knowledge of Network Devices such as Switches, Routers, Wireless Access Points preferably CISCO, Riverbed

- Basics knowledge / understanding of assigning switch ports to specific VLANs

- Patch phone ports to switch as needed

- Basic troubleshooting of Avaya VOIP phones (knowledge on basic configuration)

- Troubleshoot issues with fiber links between switches – Able to visualize errors and communicate to remote technical teams

- Troubleshoot and replace network switch chassis blades when required

- Good to have understanding of any Data Center Infrastructure Management Application

- A periodic (minimum twice weekly) visual check of the IDF rooms for cooling and power status (specifically UPS alarms and PDU health) Control-M, EMC Avamar, Data Domain

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You'll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.

Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Global Leadership Trainee (Mars Program)
description:

You will have 2 to 4 Job rotations covering B-side, C-side, D-side and Business Analysis in the first two years. The specific job responsibilities depend on which position you will take. Generally, it may include:

1. Assist in formulating and executing the overall strategy for the food delivery platform, ensuring competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets. Analyze industry trends, user demands, technological innovations, and global competition to provide strategic recommendations and support executive decisions.

2. Collaborate with global teams to optimize operations, improve order conversion rates, and enhance customer retention across international markets. Tailor strategies based on regional user needs and local market characteristics.

3. Analyze international market behavior and demand shifts, and implement product and service innovations to increase global market share and customer satisfaction.

4. Conduct regular industry analysis, track competitive landscapes, market dynamics, and technological developments, and continuously update the global strategic plan. Establish and monitor KPIs to assess strategy execution.

5. Build and maintain strategic partnerships with global stakeholders including merchants, delivery providers, payment platforms, and logistics partners to strengthen market position and brand presence.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor degree(Master/MBA degree is a plus) with experience in strategy planning, business analysis, or consulting in the food delivery, e-commerce, or tech industries. Cross-department collaboration and project management experience is essential.

2. Strong international market insights with the ability to analyze data and identify global opportunities and risks in the food delivery sector.

3. Familiarity with food delivery platform operations, including merchant management, logistics, and payment systems, with the ability to drive optimization and innovation in international markets.

4. Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills (Speaking Arabic/Portuguese is a Plus), and the ability to collaborate and execute strategies in a global work environment.

5. Proficient in office software, with strong analytical and strategic thinking skills to quickly identify opportunities and risks and make informed decisions.

6. Strong team spirit, execution capabilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, ensuring effective cross-departmental collaboration and strategy implementation.

Job Highlights:

Join us to collaborate with a world-class team, driving innovation and growth for our food delivery platform in global markets, while enjoying extensive career development opportunities. Below are what makes this role even more exciting!

1. Expand Your Horizons with a "Startup Opportunity": Join Keeta's international journey and will have the chance to take the lead in building a team from scratch in new markets. As you help the business grow rapidly, you'll also experience continuous and accelerated personal development.

2. Mentorship from Top Executives: Receive one-on-one coaching from Keeta's senior executives. Participate in important internal project and get close to business decision-making processes.

3. Diverse Rotations & Clear Career Path: Rotate across key business areas (merchants, users, riders) to gain a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery business. Rotate across different markets to understand and adapt to local demands. Rotate through different business stages (stable operation, 0-1 expansion) to become a versatile business expert.

title: Information Technology Specialist
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.
  • Expected Results
  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Should be able to communicate in English
  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Engenheiro De Homologação
description:
Engenheiro de Homologação

A Jetour está comprometida em construir, no mercado brasileiro, uma marca automotiva centrada no cliente e impulsionada por tecnologia.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Sênior de Homologação Regulatória, que atuará como elo estratégico entre produto, tecnologia e as regulamentações locais no Brasil.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir que nossos veículos estejam plenamente em conformidade com as exigências regulatórias brasileiras, além de participar ativamente da definição da estratégia de localização de produtos, contribuindo de forma decisiva para o lançamento bem-sucedido e a competitividade contínua no mercado.

Responsabilidades:

-Gestão de projetos de homologação

Coordenar integralmente os projetos de homologação de veículos no Brasil, incluindo o planejamento e acompanhamento de testes, preparação e submissão de documentação técnica, bem como obtenção e manutenção de certificações.

-Interface com órgãos e auditorias

Atuar como representante técnico da empresa perante órgãos certificadores locais e junto ao time global de homologação, liderando interações, auditorias e respostas a questionamentos técnicos, garantindo a conformidade regulatória dos produtos.

-Monitoramento regulatório

Acompanhar e interpretar continuamente as atualizações de leis, normas e políticas no Brasil (como emissões, segurança e eficiência energética), assegurando a comunicação eficaz dessas mudanças para as equipes globais de P&D.

-Suporte técnico e colaboração

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes globais de engenharia, contribuindo com visão regulatória para adaptação local de produtos, otimização técnica e desenvolvimento.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa (ou superior) em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Automotiva, Engenharia Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em homologação/regulamentação no setor automotivo
  • Sólido conhecimento da regulamentação brasileira CONAMA 492/2018 (Proconve L8) e dos processos de certificação veicular junto ao INMETRO, bem como entendimento das tendências futuras do Proconve L8
  • Conhecimento da arquitetura de veículos a combustão e híbridos, incluindo sistemas de powertrain
  • Inglês e português fluentes

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com veículos eletrificados/híbridos
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de calibração e teste, como ETAS INCA, CANoe, com capacidade de apoiar testes de emissões, OBD e análise de dados

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Analista De Fp&A Sênior
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.

Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.

Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.

Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.

O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

Sobre a área de Finanças

A área financeira na Juntos Somos Mais desempenha um papel fundamental na sustentabilidade e crescimento dos nossos produtos. Somos responsáveis por gerenciar os recursos financeiros com eficiência, garantindo que todas as operações ocorram de forma estruturada, ágil e em conformidade com as melhores práticas do mercado.

Nosso time atua diretamente em três frentes principais:

- Faturamento e Prestação de Serviços: Gestão do faturamento, emissão de notas fiscais e apuração de receitas, garantindo conformidade tributária, adequação à reforma e eficiência nos processos.

- Contas a Pagar e Gestão de Fornecedores: Administração dos pagamentos da empresa, controle de fluxo de caixa e otimização de processos financeiros.

- FP&A: Apoio na análise de dados financeiros e viabilidade de novos projetos, geração de insights para tomada de decisão e otimização de performance.

Principais desafios da área:

- Automatização e digitalização de processos para maior escalabilidade e eficiência

- Integração com outras áreas para fornecer insights estratégicos e apoiar a tomada de decisão

- Equilíbrio entre eficiência operacional e governança financeira, garantindo conformidade e agilidade

Seu papel:

  • Acompanhar a performance da companhia por meio de análises mensais de resultados, rentabilidade de projetos, ganhos em campanhas e projeções financeiras;
  • Conduzir os processos de fechamento, alocação de custos e apuração de receitas em parceria com o time de Contabilidade;
  • Liderar os ciclos de Planejamento Estratégico, Orçamento (Budget) e Revisões Periódicas (Forecast), garantindo alinhamento entre áreas e visão de longo prazo;
  • Preparar relatórios financeiros completos, incluindo DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa, com visão crítica e foco em direcionar decisões;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar relatórios gerenciais e de prestação de contas em ferramentas como Excel e Metabase, assegurando consistência e transparência nas entregas;
  • Elaborar materiais executivos para reuniões internas e apresentações ao Conselho, conectando dados financeiros à narrativa estratégica do negócio;
  • Realizar análises financeiras aprofundadas, incluindo custos, margens, despesas e oportunidades de eficiência operacional e redução de custos;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas, avaliando oportunidades de crescimento e contribuindo com projeções e modelos financeiros robustos;
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, cenário econômico e mudanças regulatórias — com destaque para os impactos da reforma tributária — e traduzir esses movimentos em orientações práticas para o negócio;
  • Supervisionar egarantir a adequação dos controles financeiros para auditorias internas e externas, assegurando conformidade e governança.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SOMASE, SE, Modelagem de dados);
  • Conhecimento deERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS);
  • Conhecimento das noções de contabilidade gerencial;
  • Custo por absorção e custo variável;
  • Margem de contribuição, EBITDA, ROIC, CAPEX, OPEX;
  • Noções de estatística e matemática financeira;

Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em VBA, Power Query, Power Pivot, modelagem relacional DAX);
  • Ferramentas de BI (Metabase, PowerBI, Tableau);
  • Familiaridade com auditoria externa;
  • IFRS e princípios contábeis brasileiros;
  • Tributação e impostos (ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS);

Se isso tudo faz sentido pra você, o próximo passo é seu. Vem ser Construtor(a) com a gente no maior Ecossistema da Construção Civil! ️

Nosso processo seletivo e o compromisso com a Diversidade:

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job

The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‐effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‐on‐the‐ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‐term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‐functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company's global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business

Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil

objectives

  • Support the efficient and cost‐effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.

What do you need?

To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‐effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‐saving or performance‐enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‐making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‐cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. title: Ehs Supervisor
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company's business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision's smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world's largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily EHS activities on-site, ensuring compliance with safety standards and procedures
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure proper control measures for high-risk activities (e.G., work at height, lifting operations, electrical works)
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Perform regular site inspections and safety audits
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented
  • Promote safety awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and company EHS policies
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or technical qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience in EHS within wind farm, construction, or energy projects is preferred
  • Strong knowledge of high-risk activities (lifting, working at heights, electrical safety)
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (to be tested)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Engenheiro De Testes E Calibração
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Testes e Calibração para garantir alta disponibilidade, confiabilidade e performance dos equipamentos de teste, atuando de forma estratégica na gestão, calibração e manutenção de toda a cadeia de medição — incluindo sensores, cabos, condicionamento de sinal e sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ).

Esta posição é referência técnica na área, apoiando engenheiros e técnicos na seleção, configuração e uso correto da instrumentação, além de liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica do parque de testes.

FORMAÇÃO

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade.
  • Planejar e executar calibração e manutenção preventiva/corretiva, assegurando conformidade metrológica e máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas.
  • Realizar diagnóstico de falhas e troubleshooting em sensores, cabos, conectores, DAQ e condicionamento de sinal, garantindo qualidade e repetibilidade das medições.
  • Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados conforme demanda dos testes, com suporte a setups em bancada e em veículo.
  • Definir e manter procedimentos, instruções e padrões de instrumentação, incluindo boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção e armazenamento.
  • Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos, promovendo o uso eficiente e correto dos sistemas de medição.
  • Conduzir análises de obsolescência e necessidades futuras, elaborando roadmaps e apoiando solicitações de investimento para atualização e expansão do parque de testes.
  • Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais, alinhando tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.

REQUISITOS

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação com times globais e fornecedores.
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo sensores (temperatura, pressão, aceleração, strain gages, entre outros).
  • Conhecimento sólido em metrologia e rotina de calibração (rastreabilidade, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos).
  • Vivência com sistemas de aquisição de dados (DAQ), incluindo configuração e troubleshooting (cabeamento, conectores, ruído, aterramento e integridade de sinal).
  • Perfil organizado, com capacidade de planejamento, priorização e gestão de documentação.
  • Boa comunicação, postura de atendimento ao cliente interno e colaboração com engenheiros e técnicos.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com ferramentas/fornecedores de DAQ como Dewesoft ou IPETRONIK.
  • Familiaridade com barramentos e protocolos veiculares (CAN, Ethernet, LIN).

CARGO

Analista de Testes e Calibração

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Horário: 2a a 6a das 08:00 às 17:15 (100% presencial);
  • Local: Curitiba-PR.
